title: Piano Zero
summary: Grand & Electric Piano Workstation for CardputerZero
description:
CardputerZero Piano Zero transforms the M5Stack CardputerZero (320x170 IPS display, 56-key matrix keyboard, ARM64 Linux) into a studio-grade sampled grand piano & electric piano workstation inspired by exxpiano.

Features a custom C++17 Direct-From-Disk (DFD) SoundFont 2 streaming engine that plays 700 MB+ (among other 4 different sound bank options) 14-velocity-layer concert grands inside ~80 MB RAM with zero underruns, real piano mechanics (hammer/damper noise, sympathetic string resonance, pedal noise), smooth Freeverb stereo hall reverb, built-in SMF MIDI player, in-app Wi-Fi Sound Bank Downloader (Salamander Full/Lite, Nice Steinway v3.8, Rhodes EPs Plus, Abbey Steinway D), USB audio auto-selection, and Universal Configurable USB MIDI Learn.
